purpose: FIRBENCH-1 S9 synthetic generator and acceptance parameters, frozen before any simulated outcome. Declared project policy under the coordinator pre-outcome contract: not canon constants, not measured ICC, not ratification and not a simulated pass.

layout.note: Nested keys are owned by the simulator. Callers rely only on schema and the acceptance report. Every object is strict: unknown keys are refused by load_params.

policy_mirror.note: Copies of manifest values. The loader refuses any difference from the decision manifest; the manifest stays the source of truth.

generator.pattern_order: Eight miss patterns in binary order 000..111 over bits (sface, auraface, insightface). Index = 4*sface + 2*auraface + insightface; bit 1 is a miss.
generator.psu_random_effect: Dirichlet via logits: logits_c = log(Gamma(k * q_c)), softmax; k = 1/ICC - 1; categories with q_c = 0 are excluded before drawing; no epsilon.
generator.faces_given_psu: Conditional on a PSU's probabilities, each face draws its pattern independently.
generator.miss_class_note: Class of a miss on a separable leg: missed = upstream undetected mate, rejected = embedded below tau, wrong_identity = embedded with another identity above tau. On the fused leg the missed class writes stage detected, which finishes as missed.
generator.score_note: Fixed declared operating threshold, not calibrated on fit folds. Correct embeddings score tau + margin*s and rejected ones tau - margin*s with s in (0, 1]. The runner-up identity scores second_score_gap lower.
generator.selection_note: The selection control keeps the in-house leg with the smaller natural estimate FNIR(leg) - FNIR(insightface) before the H1 forcing. Exact ties resolve to the leg named here.
generator.background_distribution: Round-robin over PSUs sorted by PSU id, using the PSU session_id as session metadata. No new independent units. Count does not change mated effective size.
generator.fold_protocol: k and seed come from the decision manifest. Test fold 0 is recorded by S1; the simulator decides on the whole synthetic population and runs no fold calibration.
generator.gallery: Every mated identity is enrolled. Background units are the only non-mated source units.

stage_planting.eligibility: GT faces whose native sface AND native auraface outcomes are embedded correct or embedded wrong in the control packet
stage_planting.stratification: wrong_drops = round_half_even(drops * eligible_wrong / eligible_total); correct_drops = drops - wrong_drops; each class sampled with the shared seeded draw

generator.attribution_note: Separable attribution rows restore the control (baseline) stage on the same GT ids; insightface attribution is unavailable_fused.
generator.frame_note: Synthetic registry entry. Confirmatory admissibility so H2 can reach non_inferior; sealed to mirror confirm-v1. Its source hash is the sha256 of the frame-v1 payload with source_sha256 nulled.

laws.joint_coupling_note: Triples are [control_pattern, planted_pattern, weight] over 400. The control marginal equals laws.null and the planted marginal equals laws.h1_power. Only the sface bit changes: 000->100, 001->101, 010->110, 011->111. Cell-only treatment applies this coupling to clear_mask PSUs; clear_clear PSUs keep identical control and planted observations.

designs.cell_allocation_rule: Sort PSUs ascending by mated size (ties by PSU id). Give the even-indexed PSUs to clear_mask and the odd-indexed PSUs to clear_clear. Whole PSUs only.

bound_200.derivation: 95% upper quantile of Binomial(200, 0.025): P(X <= 8) = 0.934, P(X <= 9) = 0.970, carried here, not in code

acceptance.cell_clear_mask_rule_note: Declared reading of the cell-only pass rule: the clear_mask rate uses the same 0.77 detection bar on its own n_eff (about 59), not the global 115. Reported with its own n_eff. Not a new limit.

guardrail.rule: report-only synthetic scope marker; no measured veto reading is supplied

synthetic_decision.note: Copies of the real manifest's policy values with synthetic frame, template and ratification entries. The real benchmarks/manifests/fir-bench-decision-v1.json is never read for write or mutated.
